title: ARGus — Agentic Rule-Grounded Screening
description: An auditable framework for image-based regulatory compliance screening against complex rule sets: a bounded retrieval agent proposes candidate rules and a rule-grounded verdict keeps every decision traceable to a clause. Code, rule library and schema, stage prompts, privacy-reviewed sample images, aggregate result summaries, and the paper's online supplement (paper/supplement.pdf) accompanying the paper "Regulation-Grounded Visual Compliance Screening of Construction Sites: Rule Applicability Retrieval, Not Visual Judgement, Governs Accuracy" (submitted to the Journal of Computing in Civil Engineering, ASCE).
